core.summary: Base HOL Light plus a tiny sentinel theorem.
core.scratch_convention: Use for tutorial, Boolean, arithmetic, and small self-contained scratch lemmas.

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC
useful_operations.hint: apply an implication or theorem shape

ring.expected_load: Heavy cold load; good candidate for cached fork seats.
ring.scratch_convention: Use for RING_RULE, REAL_RING, and polynomial/algebra scratch lemmas.

useful_operations.name: RING_RULE
useful_operations.hint: prove pure ring equalities as a theorem

useful_operations.name: REAL_RING
useful_operations.hint: real polynomial identity conversion; not a tactic by itself

useful_operations.name: CONV_TAC REAL_RING
useful_operations.hint: invoke the REAL_RING conversion on the current goal

useful_operations.name: REAL_FIELD
useful_operations.hint: field identities with nonzero side conditions

useful_operations.name: ASM_SIMP_TAC[]
useful_operations.hint: discharge simplification side conditions from assumptions

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC
useful_operations.hint: apply algebraic lemmas by conclusion shape

real-algebra.summary: Lightweight real arithmetic and polynomial algebra setup.
real-algebra.expected_load: Moderate cold load; cheaper than full Multivariate/realanalysis for REAL_ARITH, REAL_RING, and calc_rat work.
real-algebra.scratch_convention: Use for real polynomial identities, inequalities, finite-difference algebra, and small analytic arithmetic before reaching for heavier analysis profiles.

useful_operations.name: REAL_RING
useful_operations.hint: conversion for polynomial real identities; not a tactic by itself

useful_operations.name: CONV_TAC REAL_RING
useful_operations.hint: invoke the REAL_RING conversion on the current goal

useful_operations.name: REAL_FIELD
useful_operations.hint: field identities after proving denominators nonzero

multivariate-physics.summary: Vector and multivariate-analysis foundation for physics/tether work.
multivariate-physics.expected_load: Heavy cold load; avoid paying this inside proof footraces.
multivariate-physics.scratch_convention: Use for vector, real-analysis, continuous-time, and tether/physics scratch lemmas.

useful_operations.name: DOT_LMUL / DOT_RMUL
useful_operations.hint: pull scalar multiplication out of dot

tether-orbit.summary: Tether-in-orbit scratch basis for scalarized 2D chain dynamics, force/mass acceleration budgets, no-slack envelopes, and light vector geometry.
tether-orbit.expected_load: Middle-heavy physics load; intended to be much cheaper than flyspeck-geom while richer than real-algebra for tether/orbit work.
tether-orbit.scratch_convention: Use for tether chain dynamics and orbit-control lemmas: keep project definitions/theorems in a source-specific base, then prove new force, mass, acceleration, energy, or no-slack bridge lemmas in scratch.

useful_operations.name: REAL_ARITH_TAC
useful_operations.hint: linear force, mass, acceleration, and one-sided envelope inequalities

useful_operations.name: CONV_TAC REAL_RING
useful_operations.hint: close polynomial energy, dot2, power, and finite-difference identities

useful_operations.name: REAL_LE_DIV / REAL_LE_LDIV_EQ
useful_operations.hint: move positive mass or length denominators across inequalities

useful_operations.name: REAL_LT_IMP_LE / REAL_LT_DIV
useful_operations.hint: turn strict positive mass/length hypotheses into nonnegative budget facts

useful_operations.name: SUM_EQ_NUMSEG / SUM_ADD_NUMSEG
useful_operations.hint: finite chain sums over nodes or segments

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC ... THEN ASM_SIMP_TAC[]
useful_operations.hint: apply existing bridge lemmas with force/mass hypotheses

useful_operations.name: MESON_TAC[...]
useful_operations.hint: thread node/segment hypotheses through quantified chain contracts

useful_operations.name: VECTOR_ARITH_TAC
useful_operations.hint: linear vector residue when moving from scalarized 2D to vector forms

useful_operations.name: NORM_ARITH_TAC
useful_operations.hint: distance/norm side goals; escalate to flyspeck-geom only for genuine 3D cross/coplanarity

tether-stable.summary: Heavy plus the pinned stable tether theorem frontier.
tether-stable.expected_load: Heavy restore followed by the pinned project cutoff during developer construction only.
tether-stable.scratch_convention: Edit only sources beyond the pinned cutoff; advance the cutoff intentionally.

multivariate-topology.summary: Topology-oriented Multivariate basis without the full realanalysis/Flyspeck stack.
multivariate-topology.expected_load: Heavy cold load; a middle rung for paths, compactness, connectedness, and topology lemmas.
multivariate-topology.scratch_convention: Use when the theorem needs Multivariate/topology.ml but not the full realanalysis or Flyspeck geometry imports.

useful_operations.name: REWRITE_TAC[path; path_image]
useful_operations.hint: open path definitions for simple curves

multivariate-complex.expected_load: Heavy cold load; useful for complex plane, Cx/drop/lift, and complex analytic scratch lemmas.
multivariate-complex.scratch_convention: Use when Complex/Multivariate complex lemmas are needed but Flyspeck is unnecessary.

useful_operations.name: COMPLEX_FIELD
useful_operations.hint: complex field identities with nonzero conditions

useful_operations.name: CX_DEF / RE_CX / IM_CX
useful_operations.hint: move between real and complex forms

calculus.summary: General-purpose real calculus profile: derivatives, continuity, mean-value/increasing lemmas, and real interval side conditions.
calculus.expected_load: Very heavy cold load; warm once before repeated calculus theorem/tactic edits.
calculus.scratch_convention: Use for derivative, MVT, monotonicity, integral, and real continuous-time scratch lemmas. Keep project definitions in a source-specific base when possible.

useful_operations.name: HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_INCREASING
useful_operations.hint: turn nonnegative derivative assumptions into monotonicity

useful_operations.name: HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_INCREASING_IMP
useful_operations.hint: increasing-function form when the derivative side condition already matches

useful_operations.name: REAL_MVT
useful_operations.hint: mean value theorem for one-dimensional real functions

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC REAL_LE_TRANS
useful_operations.hint: spell out comparison chains instead of hoping arithmetic guesses them

useful_operations.name: ASM_SIMP_TAC[]
useful_operations.hint: simplify analytic side conditions from assumptions

useful_operations.name: REAL_ARITH_TAC
useful_operations.hint: finish linear scalar inequalities after products are normalized

realanalysis.scratch_convention: Use only when the lighter multivariate-physics profile is missing definitions or theorems.

flyspeck-geom.summary: Full Flyspeck-adjacent 3D geometry: polytopes, realanalysis, geom, cross products, complex/topology imports, and Flyspeck geometry lemmas.
flyspeck-geom.expected_load: Very heavy full load; measured 824.6s direct, about 195k stdout lines, and about 2.3GB RSS on Ben's Mac on 2026-06-01. A one-seat fork warm pool took about 14m12s, about 194k basis lines, and peaked near 3.9GB RSS during preload. Warm deliberately, usually with --pool-size 1.
flyspeck-geom.scratch_convention: Use only when lighter multivariate/realanalysis profiles miss Flyspeck-specific sphere-packing, 3D geometry, cross-product, coplanar/collinear, slice/dropout, or Flyspeck lemmas.

useful_operations.name: ORTHOGONAL_CROSS
useful_operations.hint: cross product is perpendicular to its inputs

useful_operations.name: CROSS_EQ_0
useful_operations.hint: zero cross product iff dependence conditions

defi-evm-arith.summary: DeFi/EVM-style uint256 arithmetic basis with generic floor mulDiv, CPMM quote surfaces, Uniswap v2 quote predicates, and reduced ALU/word-operation trace adapters.
defi-evm-arith.expected_load: Moderate HOL library load: words, integer helpers, bitmatch, records, local DeFi/CPMM definitions, Uniswap v2 quote predicates, value-level arithmetic-operation traces, stack-boundary theorems, and reduced ADD/MUL/SUB/DIV operation-list trace definitions.
defi-evm-arith.scratch_convention: Use for theorem-only uint256, modular arithmetic, fixed-point rounding, and AMM arithmetic kernels. Keep needs/new_definition in proofs/defi_evm_arith_base.ml.

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC EVM_STACK_MUL_SMALL
useful_operations.hint: reduce bounded stack multiplication to natural multiplication

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC EVM_STACK_SUB_SMALL
useful_operations.hint: reduce non-underflowing stack subtraction to natural subtraction

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC EVM_STACK_UDIV_SMALL
useful_operations.hint: reduce stack unsigned division to natural division

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC EVM_STACK_ADD1_SMALL
useful_operations.hint: reduce bounded stack increment to natural addition

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC UINT256_VALUE_WORD_OF_SMALL_FOR_STACK
useful_operations.hint: preserve the value of a bounded natural encoded as a :256 word

useful_operations.name: REWRITE_TAC[UNISWAP_V2_GET_AMOUNT_OUT_SUCCESS_EXPANDS_FOR_STACK]

useful_operations.name: REWRITE_TAC[UNISWAP_V2_GET_AMOUNT_IN_SUCCESS_EXPANDS_FOR_STACK]

useful_operations.name: MATCH_MP_TAC UNISWAP_V2_GET_AMOUNT_IN_QUOTIENT_UINT256_VALUE_FOR_STACK
useful_operations.hint: show the successful getAmountIn quotient fits uint256

useful_operations.name: REWRITE_TAC[evm_stack_step_trace]
